## nowaki dev

Start the dev server.

| Argument or flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<DIR>` | `.` | App root directory |
| `--port -p <PORT>` |  | Port to listen on (default: PORT, else 3000) |
| `--host <ADDR>` |  | Address to listen on; `--host` alone listens on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) [default: NOWAKI_HOST, else 127.0.0.1] |
| `--open` |  | Open the default browser after startup |
| `--no-toolbar` |  | Don't load the dev toolbar in the browser (same as NOWAKI_TOOLBAR=0) |
| `--help -h` |  | Print help |

## nowaki build

Build for production and emit output for the deploy adapter.

| Argument or flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<DIR>` | `.` | App root directory |
| `--adapter <ADAPTER>` | `node` | Deploy target adapter (node\|static\|bun\|deno\|cloudflare\|vercel) Values: `node`, `static`, `bun`, `deno`, `cloudflare`, `vercel`. |
| `--help -h` |  | Print help (see more with '--help') |

| `--host <ADDR>` |  | Address to listen on; `--host` alone listens on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) [default: NOWAKI_HOST, else 127.0.0.1] |

## nowaki prerender

Prerender as a static site (SSG).

| Argument or flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<DIR>` | `.` | App root directory |
| `--out -o <OUT>` | `dist/static` | Output directory (relative to dir, or absolute) |
| `--skip-build` |  | Render from existing `dist/` (`nowaki build`); skips the transform and content-index steps |
| `--help -h` |  | Print help |

## nowaki upgrade

Update nowaki (CLI) and @nowaki-dev/runtime to the latest version.

| Argument or flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<DIR>` | `.` | App root directory |
| `--to <TO>` |  | Version or npm dist-tag to update to (default: latest), e.g. --to 1.0.0 or --to next. A version on a newer major first prints a readiness report and installs nothing while it lists something to change |
| `--check` |  | Only print the readiness report for --to (read-only; exits 1 when something must change) |
| `--help -h` |  | Print help |

## create-nowaki

`npm create nowaki@latest [dir] [flags]` (also `create-nowaki-app`) scaffolds an app. On a terminal it asks for what the flags don't say; without one (CI, a pipe, `-y`) it uses the defaults.

| Argument or flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--install` | Install dependencies even without prompts (they are skipped by default then). |
| `--no-git` | Don't offer to initialize a git repository. |
| `--no-install` | Don't install dependencies. |
| `--pm <value>` | The package manager to install with (`npm`, `pnpm`, `yarn`, `bun`). Default: the one that ran the command, else npm. |
| `--template <value>` | The template: see the list below. Default `basics`. |
| `--yes` | No prompts: every question takes its default. |
| `-t <value>` | Short for `--template`. |
| `-y` | Short for `--yes`. |
| `<dir>` | The directory to create (must be missing or empty). Asked for on a terminal; `nowaki-app` otherwise. |

| Template | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `basics` | starter with an interactive island |
| `minimal` | a single page, zero islands |
